scheme_name: Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: Accidental death or Permanent Total Disability Gujarat
description:
The Group Accident Insurance Scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) was launched by the Government of India in 2020. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fishers and fish farmers in the event of accidental death or permanent total disability. 

The PMMSY was introduced on September 29, 2020, with a budget allocation of ₹20,050 crores over a five-year period. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the socio-economic conditions of fishers and fish farmers by providing them with a safety net against unforeseen accidents. 

The scheme specifically targets individuals engaged in fisheries and aquaculture activities across the country. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme offers a coverage amount of ₹2 lakh for accidental death. 

In the case of permanent total disability, the scheme provides a coverage amount of ₹2 lakh as well. 

The insurance coverage is designed to support the families of fishers in case of an unfortunate event. 

The scheme is particularly beneficial for those who work in hazardous conditions and face risks associated with fishing activities. 

To be eligible for this scheme, applicants must be engaged in fishing or aquaculture activities. 

The age limit for beneficiaries is set between 18 to 70 years. 

The scheme is open to both men and women involved in the fisheries sector. 

There is no specific income criteria mentioned for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, beneficiaries must be registered under the Fisheries Department of their respective states. 

The application process for the Group Accident Insurance Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must first register with the Fisheries Department in their state. 

They need to provide documentation proving their involvement in fishing or aquaculture. 

Required documents typically include identity proof, address proof, and registration certificates from the Fisheries Department. 

Once registered, beneficiaries will automatically be enrolled in the insurance scheme. 

The scheme does not require any premium payment from the beneficiaries. 

The insurance coverage is provided free of cost to the registered fishers and fish farmers. 

The disbursement of claims under the scheme is processed through the respective state Fisheries Departments. 

In the event of an accident leading to death or permanent total disability, beneficiaries or their families must file a claim. 

The claim process involves submitting necessary documents such as the death certificate or medical reports confirming disability. 

The claims are typically settled within a stipulated time frame of 30 to 45 days. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Fisheries Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

The scheme is administered at the state level by the respective Fisheries Departments. 

Each state has designated officials responsible for overseeing the implementation of the scheme. 

The contact details for the Fisheries Department can be found on the official state government websites. 

The scheme is part of a larger initiative to promote sustainable fisheries and improve the livelihoods of fishers. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has seen significant uptake among fishers across various states. 

The Government of Gujarat has actively promoted this scheme among local fishers. 

Awareness campaigns have been conducted to educate fishers about the benefits of the scheme. 

The scheme is expected to cover millions of fishers nationwide. 

The Government of India aims to ensure that all eligible fishers are aware of and enrolled in the scheme. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a vital component of the PMMSY. 

It aligns with the broader goals of improving the welfare of fishers and enhancing their economic resilience. 

The scheme also contributes to the overall development of the fisheries sector in India. 

The Government of India has emphasized the importance of social security for fishers. 

The scheme is designed to provide peace of mind to fishers and their families. 

It addresses the vulnerabilities faced by individuals engaged in this sector. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to supporting the livelihoods of fishers. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a proactive measure to safeguard the interests of fishers. 

It aims to reduce the financial burden on families in times of crisis. 

The scheme also encourages more individuals to engage in fisheries and aquaculture activities. 

The Government of India continues to monitor and evaluate the implementation of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is an essential step towards ensuring the welfare of fishers in India. 

It reflects the government's dedication to enhancing the socio-economic status of those in the fisheries sector. 

The scheme has the potential to significantly impact the lives of millions of fishers and their families. 

The initiative is part of a broader strategy to promote sustainable development in the fisheries sector. 

The Government of India remains committed to providing comprehensive support to fishers through various welfare schemes. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY is a crucial aspect of this commitment. 

It is designed to create a safety net for fishers and their families in times of need. 

The scheme is expected to evolve and adapt based on the changing needs of the fisheries community. 

Overall, the Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a significant welfare initiative that aims to uplift the lives of fishers and their families across India.
